shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH and VEF PipeSystem as soft compat.
- Soft-compat hard rule: foreign types ONLY as locals inside method bodies of gated classes — never in signatures, fields, properties, or attributes (attribute scans resolve signature types even for never-called methods).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics.
- Basement: solid mineable rock, fogged, thick-roofed, stable 12C underground; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Animal policy (T7, user-locked, conservative): pets follow their master through stairs (follow flags + 12-cell radius), obedient pets get send up/down gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals NEVER cross.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; fail open everywhere. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.

## How it works (T0-T4, T6 verified in-game; T7 code done pending run)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; loss-proof StairTransfer; PageUp/PageDown level view.
- See-below renderer: whitelisted content layers (incl. water depth); air-cells light mask; live dynamic things; silhouettes suppressed during offset pass. Ceiling hints on the surface under built sky floors (toggleable).
- Weather: 150-tick surface sync + pocket-level WeatherDecider suppressed. Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops via the roof cascade.
- Cross-level work migration (virtual position scans), idle return, drafted gizmos.
- Logistics (T3 + T7): outbound haul (storage verdicts + demand pull + right-click), inbound fetch WorkGiver (AB_FetchFromOtherLevels, Hauling priorityInType 8, bounded virtual scans, 450t empty-scan cooldown), quantity-aware export pinning. StairTransfer finishes cargo deliveries deterministically (HaulToStorageJob enqueued on arrival; drop-at-exit fallback) — vanilla's carried-thing storing is gated behind WorkGiver_HaulGeneral.ShouldSkip and never fires on maps with an empty haulables lister.
- Demand (CrossLevelDemand): construction (exact remaining counts) + production bills (shortfall of one batch, aggregate availability across ingredient alternatives — stocked kitchens pull nothing) + patient/prisoner meals (2 per mouth across 5 meal types, aggregated).
- Needs (T7): rest routes one hop toward the owned bed anywhere in the column (two-hop works); no owned bed = route to a linked level with a free bed. Food: colonists AND eligible pets take stairs when vanilla finds nothing local but food exists on a linked level (virtual FoodUtility check). 300t fail cooldowns.
- Medical + prisoners (T7): WorkGiver_ABRescueAcrossLevels (Doctor, emergency, priority 70) rescues downed colony pawns toward linked-level beds when no local bed exists — carry through stairs, land at exit, queued vanilla Rescue continuation to the bed found on arrival. Capture: right-click order (hostile/factionless downed only, only when no local prisoner bed) with queued Capture continuation. CarriedIntent enum on StairTransfer picks the continuation.
- One-colony UI: Work/Schedule/etc tables append other levels' colonists; Schedule also appends other levels' controllable ghouls (gated to the Schedule window — Work chains the same base getter and must not show them); Animals tab (separate non-chaining override) patched to append other levels' colony animals.
- Power: stairwell battery-pair links (10t equalization, bank forwarding, no storage UI). Pipes: DBH water + VEF PipeSystem equalization (clean-signature bridges). Climate: sky mirrors surface temps; stairwell heat exchange.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/ledge rock on natural roof loss below (rare); sky projectile dim over open air (cosmetic). Both slated for field manual.
- Bill ingredient radius: cross-level delivery lands loose at the stairs; a bench with a small ingredient search radius may not see it (same as any distant drop; default radius is unbounded).
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Profiling notes (T7 additions all bounded)
Fetch giver: per-pawn 450t cooldown, max 25 items per scan, rides 600t verdict cache. Demand rebuild per map per 600t now also walks bills (caps 30 bills/40 defs) and spawned pawns once. Needs redirects: postfixes on GetFood/GetRest with 300t fail cooldowns. Rescue giver: emergency-class scan over SpawnedDownedPawns only. Follow pull: one faction-pawn walk per transfer event.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T4, T6 DONE + verified. T7 CODE DONE (all 7: bills demand, medical rescue + meal demand, two-hop beds + free-bed fallback + food redirect incl. pets, fetch WorkGiver, ghouls in Schedule, animal policy trio, prisoner capture + warden feeding via meal demand) — verification run pending.
- Next: T10 QoL/UI (stair variety incl. elevators, climb scaling, minified stairs, level widget, camera sub-cell, colonist bar grouping, alerts audit). Then T5 publishing prep.
- Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
T7 compiled green. T7 verification run pending, then T10.
